theme_architecture.description: A vibrant, energetic SaaS cost intelligence platform transitioning from Dark 'Swiss Brutalism' to a bright, culturally resonant 'African-energy' theme. The architecture uses a base vibrant theme with CSS variable swapping at runtime via a workspace-level country picker (e.g., data-country="NG").
theme_architecture.implementation_strategy: Use Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui. Define base tokens (electric-blue/teal/lime) in `:root`. Override these tokens in `[data-country="XX"]` selectors for ~20 countries. Currency formatting must map dynamically to the selected country state.

headings.usage: Dashboard titles, KPI values, hero section. Use tracking-tight for impactful sizes.

body.usage: Data tables, sidebars, forms, tooltips, general UI text.

NG.pattern_description: Green-white-green energy; subtle woven linear textures.

KE.pattern_description: Maasai-inspired red/black/green accents with geometric borders.

ZA.pattern_description: Vibrant structural lines and multicolour flag geometry.

GH.pattern_description: Black star motifs mixed with rich gold and red overlays.

EG.pattern_description: Eagle motifs, geometric gold accents on white.

MA.pattern_description: Star-pentagram outlines and mosaic geometric textures.

TZ.pattern_description: Diagonal sweeps of blue, yellow, and green.

ET.pattern_description: Star emblem geometry and vivid green/yellow/red bands.

UG.pattern_description: Crested crane textures and bold black/yellow/red stripes.

RW.pattern_description: Sun motif in yellow with vivid sky blue backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.corners: Friendly, modern curves. `rounded-2xl` for main cards and dashboard tiles. `rounded-xl` for inner widgets and buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Replace harsh borders with soft, ambient lighting: `shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]` on cards. Hover lift expands shadow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Subtle `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70` for sticky headers or dropdowns. CRITICAL: Never fully transparent if content is underneath. Always 1px inner border to retain shape.
visual_enhancers.textures: Map country specific flavors to subtle SVG geometric patterns or CSS linear gradients on the Dashboard Hero or Sidebar.

components.hero: Vibrant intro section. Displays greeting, overarching KPI summaries (cost per vehicle, downtime). Features an atmospheric background layer driven by the country's flavor.
components.sidebar: Clean left-nav container. Might adopt a very faint tint of the country's primary color (`bg-primary/5`).
components.cards: Generous padding (`p-6` to `p-8`). Solid white base (`bg-white`) to ground the vibrant charts and metrics.
components.charts: Playful data-viz via Recharts. Bar charts must have rounded tops `radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]}`. Pie charts with distinct padding. Chart colors bound to CSS variables `var(--chart-1)`.
components.kanban: Maintenance board with columns for 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done'. Cards feature colored edge-tags for priority.

grids_and_layouts.bento_dashboard: Use a 4-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4`). Span main analytics (e.g. Health Trend) across 2 or 3 columns.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: Use `gap-6` or `gap-8` between widgets. Padding within containers should be high.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense tabular data and text. Maintain optical balance with icons.

motion.hover_states: Cards subtly elevate: `-translate-y-1` and shadow deepens. Buttons scale lightly: `active:scale-95 transition-transform`.
motion.chart_animations: Enable default Recharts entry animations. Add staggered fade-ins to dashboard widgets on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary colors meet 4.5:1 ratio against white. For yellow/gold primary (e.g. Ghana), force `text-black` on buttons.
accessibility.focus: All interactives MUST use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="country-picker-select"`).

image_urls.description: Intricate geometric mosaic tile pattern for African textures

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Strip all references to the old 'Swiss Brutalism' dark theme (remove #080809 bg, sharp grid borders). Replace with the vibrant light-base architecture. 2. Build a Workspace Settings/Header dropdown to select the Country. This must change a React state that applies `data-country={countryCode}` to the root HTML or App wrapper. 3. Define the CSS variable map in index.css covering :root (base vibrant) and [data-country="XX"] overrides. 4. Build the KPI dashboard (9 tiles), vehicle checklist, maintenance kanban, drivers list, parts inventory, and incidents. 5. Integrate Recharts mapping to var(--chart-1)...var(--chart-5). 6. Format all costs dynamically based on the selected country currency symbol. 7. Use Lucide-react icons, NOT emojis. 8. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js (or .jsx).
